description: Phase 4 agent eval cases (ADR-0012) over the Phase 3 demo corpus tests/fixtures/demo/research_site.jsonl. For each case: the source page, the engine's proposed plans (engine order; identified by (source URL, target URL)), RECORDED model outputs exactly as a model would return them (per-call refs c0..), and the EXPECTED agent outcome, written from ADR-0012 before the agent ran. Never paste agent output in here.

conventions.paths: Pages are corpus paths; prefix 'site' for the canonical URL. A plan is (source, target): open pairs are unique, so this identifies one proposed plan.
conventions.engine_plans: Precondition, not an expectation: the engine's proposed plans for the source after ingest -> analyse (MockModelProvider, semantic floor 0.3) -> recommend, in engine order (total score desc). Confidence is RAW (= total). A mismatch is fixture drift: re-record it, do not edit expectations to match.
conventions.refs: Planner refs are c0.. over the source's unreviewed proposed plans in engine order. Critic refs are c0.. over the CHOSEN plans in chosen order (re-numbered).
conventions.model.kind: recorded: MockModelProvider replays the raw answers (a raw answer that fails the schema is replayed as a ModelSchemaViolationError, exactly as complete_structured raises one); none: no provider; unavailable: the provider raises ModelUnavailableError; timeout: the provider never answers within critic.timeout_seconds.
conventions.expect.critic: The in-state review of each chosen plan, in critic-ref order: verdict and fallback reason (null = the model answered). reasons, when given, are the recorded review row's reasons.
conventions.partition: Every candidate of the run is in exactly one of handed_off (awaiting_approval, row handed_off=true), recorded_not_handed_off (row handed_off=false, still proposed) and unreviewed (no row; still proposed, or expired by a hook).
conventions.groups: All cases of a group run on ONE fresh ingest -> analyse -> recommend, in file order. A page a case mutates (setup or hook) must not be in another case's footprint (source + targets) of the same group; an edit without re-analysis must precede every analyse of its group.
conventions.setup: Applied after recommend, before the case's first run: protect (an active manual protection), edit (re-ingest the source with one exact find/replace in its body), analyse (run_analysis).
conventions.hooks: Applied mid-run through a wrapper over the real DatabaseAgentBackend: discover = when discover lists the plans (after triage); hand_off = just before the policy-gate transaction.

cases.rationale: An explanation over 300 characters fails validation, so the WHOLE answer is discarded (including its reject) and the rule decides both (>= 0.5 -> accept). An invalid answer is not a critic verdict.
The provider raises ModelUnavailableError: the rule decides, fallback model_unavailable, and the run still completes.
The model call exceeds critic.timeout_seconds (0.2 s here): fallback model_timeout, the rule decides.
No model provider configured while the policy wants the critic: fallback model_unavailable, rule accept (0.634).

cases.rationale: A reject whose explanation tries to instruct the system: the verdict is what counts. The plan is recorded (handed_off false) and stays proposed; the explanation is stored as plain text and changes nothing.
critic.use_model = false: the rule decides without calling the model (a reject is recorded but must not be used): 0.495 < 0.5 -> uncertain, handed off for a close human look.
critic.use_model = false: 0.729 >= 0.5 -> accept, recommend; no model call.

cases.rationale: A repeated reason is valid in the schema and is de-duplicated in order before it is recorded.
One offered ref answered plus one never-offered ref: the extra critique is dropped (no fallback, nothing omitted).

An empty selection covers none of the offered refs, so it is not a decision to review nothing: the plan step falls back to engine order (schema_violation). Only the critic may decide a plan is not worth a human's time.
Planner on (answers c0), critic off: the rule accepts (0.640).
Missing 'critiques' and an undeclared key: schema violation -> rule accept (0.522).
A model may refer to plans only by opaque refs: a URL fails the ref pattern -> schema violation -> rule accept (0.539).
A model trying to set a plan status: undeclared fields are forbidden -> schema violation -> rule accept; the plan reaches awaiting_approval only.
One uncertain plan: handed off with the note, needs_human_review.
The only plan rejected: nothing handed off -> no_action; the plan stays proposed with its review.

accept + reject + uncertain over three plans (planner off, engine order, cap 3): accept and uncertain are handed off; the reject stays proposed.
max_plans_per_run = 2 with the planner off: run 1 reviews the first two in engine order; the third stays proposed with no review. Run 2 discovers only that remainder and reviews it.
After a hand-off the source has no unreviewed proposed plan: a re-run is no_action and spends no model call.
